same_version_reason: A-004/D-010 require a real consumer update from formal v0.12.0 assets, not a v0.11-to-v0.12 self-upgrade. v0.11.0 has no updater, so the first updater-bearing release can only be proven by official-zip bootstrap plus installed-updater dry-run/real transaction against formal v0.12.0. On-disk install-state 0.12.0, matching skills archive SHA-256, and rollback dir evidence satisfy that first-updater-version bar without proving cross-version upgrade.

evidence.detail: A-004 F-001 required fixed path and D-010 accept fixed for 0.12.0/v0.12.0: freeze matrix/CHANGELOG/pins, refresh 12 runtime cells, require-ready plus strict release evidence, annotated tag/Release, formal-asset checks, and one real consumer update. Independent disk/GitHub evidence covers those items; F-002/F-003 remain recommended only.

findings.summary: Formal v0.12.0 Release now ships updater and upgrade guide; compatibility readiness has 12 fresh runtime units; consumer completed a real same-version update to formal v0.12.0 with manifest/rollback evidence.
A-004 discoverability/manual-rollback README polish remains open; no independent evidence upgrades it to required or closes it.
A-004 migration dry-run/tooling gap remains open; additive migration evidence does not independently close it.

limitations: The auditor did not re-execute the online updater transaction; it verified on-disk install-state, rollback state, and official assets.
The audit did not load AGENTS.md or /audit skills and did not treat A-005 as authority.
The transaction is same-version v0.12.0 to v0.12.0; no cross-version upgrade evidence is claimed.
Published release-evidence.json retains releaseStatus release-candidate while attached to the formal Release.
The independent audit does not decide lifecycle state.
recommendation: Accept F-001 as fixed on independent formal-asset and same-version real-update evidence; keep F-002/F-003 recommended; record release/run/hash/update facts without claiming cross-version proof.
